entities.summary: Coquese Makebra Washington is a basketball coach and former player, who was the head women's basketball coach for the Rutgers Scarlet Knights from 2022 to 2026. Washington holds a Juris Doctor degree and was the first president of the WNBA Players Association, holding that position from 1999 to 2001. She played high school basketball at Flint Central High School and collegiate basketball at the University of Notre Dame.
